The shopkeeper told you these aren't normal plants and to "prepare yourself". Strange. Either way, the instructions on these seed bags say to plant a Sunflower first. But surprisingly, right after placing the seed, the Sunflower just grew to maturity near immediately, and even has a face? Not only that, but it starts speaking in a flirtatious manner. What have you gotten yourself into...*
